content: {"a_point": "In a provisional debt enforcement proceeding, the creditor can obtain provisional legal relief only if the debtor fails to credibly rebut the enforceable debt acknowledgment; if the debtor credibly demonstrates that he was legally incapable at the time of signing, the court must deny provisional relief unless the creditor proves by document that the debtor could still validly obligate himself or the debtor’s representative does not contest this claim.", "b_propositions": [{"a_id": "S54", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "rule"}, {"a_id": "S72", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "answer"}, {"a_id": "S68", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "answer"}]}
